newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Explosion rocks Pakistani city of Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rocks Pakistani city of Karachi.

text.p: An explosion jolted a central district in the Pakistani city of Karachi on Wednesday, police said.

There was no immediate report of casualties and it was not clear what had caused the blast, which occurred near the headquarters of state-owned Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation, where several multinational companies also have offices.
Witnesses said at least eight people had been wounded, most of them slightly, in the blast, which happened in the middle of the day when many office workers had gone for lunch or prayers.
The explosion, apparently caused by a bomb, occurred ahead of the planned arrival in Karachi of ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto, but there was no immediate evidence of a link.
Six people were hurt by a car bomb blast outside a shopping centre in Lahore, capital of Punjab province, on Tuesday while Chinese President Jiang Zemin was visiting the city.
